verdict.rationale: Brex documents receipt matching and receipt uploads in its Expenses API, and markets 'automated receipts' for expenses, so the core of auto-attaching uploaded receipts to card transactions is evidenced. The evidence is only one-line descriptions, with no detail on how matching works or on in-app or mobile uploads. Missing for 10: any evidence of email-forwarding receipt capture, documentation of how automatic matching selects the right transaction, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
